name: Auburn (United States)
description: White field charged with the city logo, a red shield-shaped label reading AUBURN Home of the Classics in white.
history: Auburn is the county seat of DeKalb County, Indiana, once home to the Auburn automobile. The file shows a banner of the city logo; Flags of the World records that the city itself reported in 2010 that it had no flag.

features.role: shield-shaped city logo reading AUBURN Home of the Classics
